title: environment case
description: A graded environment harvested from a fix commit. Start at base_sha; grade with test_cmd, which runs the fail_to_pass tests. Those tests fail at base_sha and pass at fix_sha. `eval-forge harvest` writes a list of these; the schema accepts one case or that list.

id.description: fix- plus the first 12 hex digits of fix_sha.

base_sha.description: The parent of the fix commit: where the environment starts.

fix_sha.description: The fix commit: a reference solution that passes the grader.

fail_to_pass.description: Repo-relative test files that fail at base_sha and pass at fix_sha.

test_cmd.description: The grading command with fail_to_pass filled in. Run from the repo root; exit 0 is a pass.
